title: Average Delivery Time
content: Average delivery time measures the average time required to complete a delivery. It is calculated using fact_deliveries.delivery_time_minutes.

title: Delay Rate
content: Delay rate measures the percentage of deliveries marked as delayed. A delivery is considered delayed when is_delayed is TRUE.

title: Average Delivery Speed
content: Average delivery speed measures the average delivery speed in kilometers per hour. It is calculated using fact_deliveries.delivery_speed_kmh.

title: Pickup Preparation Time
content: Pickup preparation time measures the time between order placement and pickup. It is calculated using fact_deliveries.pickup_prep_minutes.
